title: Primeness property for regular gradings
summary: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$ and $G$ a finite abelian group. For a $G$-graded $K$-algebra $A$, we define the primeness property for graded central polynomials: for any graded polynomials $f$ and $g$ in disjoint sets of variables, if $fg$ is graded central, then both $f$ and $g$ are graded central. Let $A=\bigoplus_{g\in G} A_g$ be its decomposition into homogeneous components.
